name: SBS Certified Business List
description:
This dataset is a directory of certified minority- and women-owned business enterprises (MWBEs) and other certified vendors, drawn from a state or city supplier-diversity program. Each of the 5,000 sampled rows represents one certified business and includes its account number, legal and doing-business-as names, contact person, phone, website, and business description, along with certification type and renewal date. Demographic fields capture ethnicity, and address fields cover both physical and mailing locations.

A large portion of the record describes each firm's capabilities and track record: six-digit NAICS code, sector, subsector and title; types of construction projects performed; NIGP commodity codes; bonding limit; union signatory status; and up to three past client references with contract value, percent self-performed, date, and work description. Additional fields note capacity-building programs and Passport enrollment.

For businesses located in New York City, the data is geocoded with latitude, longitude, borough, community board,
